slides.headline: Hyper-Targeting
slides.body_text: Traditional architectures force synchronous state blocking across every boundary. Decoupled systems publish events and immediately release threads.
slides.insight_text: Strategic decoupling with exponential backoff circuits prevents cascading outages under high load.

slides.headline: The 4 Architecture
slides.panel1_text: Ensure repeated network requests never create duplicate state records across databases.
slides.panel2_text: Isolate poisoned payloads automatically without stopping continuous stream processing.
slides.panel3_text: Fail fast during upstream degradation to preserve core transaction throughput.
slides.panel4_text: Track tail latency across distributed agent boundaries in real time.

slides.headline: Key Architectural Insight

items.text: Start with REST APIs for standard CRUD workloads.
Move to GraphQL when optimizing mobile payload sizes.
Use WebSockets only when real-time updates are mandatory.

slides.cta_highlight: You'll need these architectural insights for your next systems design interview.
